result.summary: The tenant called to say she booked the oven repair with the contractor for 8 September 2025, not the 30/08/2025 slot on our system. She needed a reply, so I didn't escalate: the contractor can settle the date. I emailed Keystone Compliance to ask which date they booked and whether anyone came on 30/08. I emailed the tenant to say we're checking with them, without promising a date. The ticket is on hold for 2 days waiting for the contractor.
result.situation: Routine oven repair: the main oven element doesn't heat but the grill works. The landlord said "Yes go ahead" (event 009) and Keystone Compliance was assigned. Our system booked a visit for 30/08/2025, 10–12 (events 017–020), and called it "Monday morning", but 30/08/2025 is a Saturday. On 30/08 (event 021) the tenant called to say she had arranged 8 September 2025 and asked us to confirm that date. The classifier marked her call for review (question 0.96, needs a human reply 0.6). The ticket is in stage 'works', but it is really still at scheduling. I didn't move it backwards.
